units.source_text: 垫被吸足了汗，湿漉漉的，

en.t: The bedding had soaked up sweat and was clammy and wet,

units.source_text: 他支起一条胳膊，撑起上半身，

en.t: he propped himself up on one arm, raising his upper body,

units.source_text: 杂七杂八的念头在脑子里打转转，

en.t: while all kinds of random thoughts spun around in his head,

units.source_text: 特意弄来的报纸，他也只是粗粗地扫了一眼版面。

en.t: and even the newspaper he had gone out of his way to get, he merely glanced over the pages roughly.
